description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relations - The Collective Agreement entered into between Paints & General Industries Ltd., and the Inter Company Employees Union
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between a company and a trade union in terms of Section 06 of the Industrial Disputes Act. It establishes legal terms and conditions for employment, wages, benefits, and dispute resolution procedures. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it involves the publication of a legally binding agreement under statutory authority, creating regulatory frameworks for industrial relations.
